<documents>
<document id="disputes-merchant-v2">
DisputingˆaˆpurchaseˆwithˆaˆmerchantˆIfˆyouˆpaidˆforˆsomethingˆwithˆyourˆcardˆandˆthere'sˆaˆproblemˆwithˆtheˆpurchaseˆitself,ˆyouˆcanˆfileˆaˆmerchantˆdispute.ˆThisˆcovers:ˆ-ˆItemsˆorˆservicesˆyouˆpaidˆforˆbutˆneverˆreceivedˆ-ˆItemsˆthatˆwereˆsignificantlyˆdifferentˆfromˆwhatˆwasˆdescribedˆ-ˆSubscriptionsˆorˆrecurringˆchargesˆthatˆcontinuedˆafterˆyouˆcancelledˆ##ˆContactˆtheˆmerchantˆfirstˆBeforeˆyouˆdispute,ˆtryˆtoˆsortˆitˆoutˆwithˆtheˆmerchant,ˆandˆkeepˆaˆrecordˆofˆwhatˆyouˆsentˆandˆwhatˆtheyˆsaid.ˆWe'llˆaskˆforˆit.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆyouˆhaveˆFileˆaˆmerchantˆdisputeˆwithinˆ120ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆtransactionˆdate.ˆAfterˆthat,ˆweˆcan'tˆopenˆaˆdisputeˆforˆyou.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆfileˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆProblemˆwithˆaˆpurchase.ˆTellˆusˆwhatˆhappenedˆandˆuploadˆyourˆrecords.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆIfˆtheˆdisputeˆpassesˆanˆinitialˆreview,ˆyouˆgetˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆWeˆthenˆcontactˆtheˆmerchantˆthroughˆtheˆcardˆnetwork.ˆMostˆcasesˆfinishˆwithinˆ45ˆdays.ˆTransactionsˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognizeˆatˆallˆareˆaˆdifferentˆkindˆofˆdispute.ˆSeeˆ"Disputingˆaˆtransactionˆyouˆdidn'tˆmake".ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="security-zero-liability">
ZeroˆliabilityˆforˆunauthorizedˆcardˆuseˆYouˆaren'tˆresponsibleˆforˆunauthorizedˆcardˆtransactionsˆifˆyouˆreportˆthemˆinˆtime.ˆ##ˆWhatˆcountsˆasˆinˆtimeˆReportˆunauthorizedˆcardˆtransactionsˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆdateˆofˆtheˆstatementˆtheyˆfirstˆappearˆon.ˆStatementsˆcloseˆonˆtheˆlastˆcalendarˆdayˆofˆeachˆmonth.ˆ##ˆWhat'sˆcoveredˆ-ˆPurchasesˆandˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆmadeˆwithˆyourˆcardˆorˆcardˆnumberˆwithoutˆyourˆpermissionˆ-ˆMobileˆwalletˆpaymentsˆmadeˆwithˆaˆdeviceˆyouˆdon'tˆcontrolˆ##ˆWhatˆisn'tˆcoveredˆ-ˆPurchasesˆmadeˆbyˆsomeoneˆyouˆgaveˆyourˆcardˆorˆPINˆtoˆ-ˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆandˆtransfersˆyouˆsentˆyourself,ˆevenˆifˆyouˆwereˆtrickedˆintoˆsendingˆthemˆ-ˆTransactionsˆreportedˆafterˆtheˆwindowˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆreportˆFreezeˆorˆreportˆyourˆcardˆfirst,ˆthenˆdisputeˆeachˆtransactionˆasˆunauthorizedˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSeeˆ"Disputingˆaˆtransactionˆyouˆdidn'tˆmake".ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="security-account-takeover">
IfˆsomeoneˆelseˆaccessedˆyourˆaccountˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆsomeoneˆelseˆhasˆsignedˆinˆtoˆyourˆaccount,ˆactˆfast.ˆ##ˆSignsˆtoˆlookˆforˆ-ˆAˆpasswordˆchangeˆorˆnew-deviceˆsign-inˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆ-ˆYourˆemailˆaddressˆorˆphoneˆnumberˆchangedˆwithoutˆyouˆ-ˆTransfersˆorˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆyouˆdidn'tˆsendˆ-ˆYou'reˆsuddenlyˆsignedˆoutˆandˆcan'tˆsignˆbackˆinˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆ1.ˆIfˆyouˆcanˆstillˆsignˆin,ˆchangeˆyourˆpasswordˆandˆfreezeˆyourˆcards.ˆ2.ˆMessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheˆapp,ˆorˆcallˆusˆifˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆin.ˆ##ˆWhatˆwe'llˆdoˆSupportˆwillˆfreezeˆyourˆcardsˆandˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆourˆFraudˆteam,ˆwhoˆhandleˆaccountˆtakeovers.ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆcontactsˆyouˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆandˆusuallyˆmuchˆfaster.ˆTheyˆmayˆsignˆoutˆeveryˆdevice,ˆresetˆyourˆcredentialsˆandˆreviewˆrecentˆactivityˆwithˆyou.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆreverseˆtransfersˆorˆchangeˆyourˆemailˆorˆphoneˆnumberˆduringˆaˆtakeoverˆinvestigation.ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆdoesˆthatˆonceˆthey'veˆconfirmedˆwhoˆyouˆare.ˆ##ˆAfterwardˆCheckˆyourˆemailˆaccount'sˆsecurityˆtoo.ˆManyˆtakeoversˆstartˆwithˆaˆcompromisedˆemail.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
